This is hymn number 96 titled "Dearest Children, God Is Near You" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William Clayton and the lyrics were written by Charles L. Walker.
